summary: Milestone 2026.05.275 has no milestone-scoped experiment commits in the authoritative timing data, so the operational record remains 0 wall-time minutes, 0 completed experiments, and 0 compute-bound experiments. Compute-bound duration, GPU efficiency, and DualGPURunner analysis are no data available this milestone.
improvements_suggested: Add a pre-closeout timing-window sentinel that emits an explicit no-data operational retrospective when no milestone-scoped experiment commit exists.
Record compute_bound and multi-model-parallel markers in the timing ledger before retrospective generation so GPU-idle and DualGPURunner checks are data-gated.
Surface an activation-window heartbeat after milestone activation so operators can detect an empty execution window before closeout.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Block runtime-ranking analysis when the milestone timing window is empty unless an explicit no-data override is present.
Make the timing collector write a compact preflight summary containing experiment count, compute-bound count, and slowest-run eligibility.
Keep GPU monitor observations contextual until compute-bound timing rows exist.
meta_reflection: The GPU monitor showed idle devices, but the timing data contains no compute-bound task, so GPU idle is not an operational bottleneck for this milestone. No savings percentage is derivable from an empty timing window; 0 is recorded as the conservative value.
